findings.finding: Female peer mentors protect women's belonging, self-efficacy, and retention in engineering during college transition.
findings.quote: Female (but not male) mentors protected women's belonging in engineering, self-efficacy, motivation, retention in engineering majors, and postcollege engineering aspirations.

findings.finding: Intensive peer mentoring during and after rehabilitation leads to greater gains in self-efficacy over time.
findings.quote: individuals receiving intensive peer mentoring during and after rehabilitation for SCI/D demonstrate greater gains in self-efficacy over time and have fewer days of unplanned rehospitalization

findings.finding: Online peer support programs improve participants' perceived ability to manage chronic conditions and satisfaction.
findings.quote: Participants who completed the iPeer2Peer Program demonstrated improvements in their perceived ability to manage JIA

principle: Structured peer mentoring and support improve self-efficacy, motivation, and skill development through regular connection.
for_the_teacher: Provide regular check-ins and structured peer support opportunities to boost learner confidence and motivation.
